description: A multi-subagent agent with external integrations and complex routing

answers.business_process: Insurance claims processing. Policyholders file new claims, check claim status, upload supporting documents, and dispute claim decisions. Adjusters review and approve claims internally.
answers.actors: Policyholders via customer portal. Claims adjusters via Service Console. External: body shop partners via API for auto claims.
answers.systems: Claim__c (custom object), Policy__c (custom object), Contact, ContentVersion for document uploads, External REST API for body shop partner status checks, Knowledge articles for policy explanations.
answers.failure_modes: Escalate to human if claim amount exceeds $50,000. Escalate if policyholder disputes a decision. If external API is down, inform user and create a follow-up task. Never approve or deny a claim — only adjusters can do that. If policy is expired, explain clearly and offer renewal options.
